definition: a motor vehicle with four wheels
description: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

taps.target: the man in the checked shirt
